calibration_model: observed_coordinate=a*true_mass_over_charge+b, with a>0. All standard ions are stipulated singly protonated neutral monomers. Fit only the two calibration-role standards; use the validation-role standard to check but not refit the line.
ion_model: For an eligible neutral candidate M, allow[n*M+z*H]^(z+) with the listed integer copy number n and positive charge number z; only added protons carry charge. Monomer internal connectivity is preserved and no neutralization, fragmentation, other adduct or isotope exchange is permitted. The isotope-tagged peaks correspond to exactly0,1or2carbon12-to-carbon13 substitutions anywhere in that same ion.

provenance.kind: Project-authored exact forward-generated mass-axis and isotope-tagged coordinates under an explicitly finite ion-assignment model. No experimentally measured spectrum, inferred cluster stability or claim that every listed ion can be produced.
